strings.privacy_body: Aura Player reads audio metadata on your device and does not upload local music files. By default, you sign in on the official NetEase HTTPS page and connect directly to NetEase. If you select a custom API service, requests are sent to that service. Session cookies are encrypted using Android Keystore and cleared when you log out or change services. Artwork and streaming contact the corresponding network services. Lyric searches send the title, artist, album and duration to NetEase, QQ, Kuwo, KuGou or LrcLib, and online song IDs to AMLL / TTML Hub. Local audio is never uploaded. Only connect to a service you trust.
